name: miraiwerk
description: MIRAIWERK AI — the intelligence engine for projects that move forward.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @miraiwerk/backend" "npm run dev -w @miraiwerk/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @miraiwerk/schemas && npm run build -w @miraiwerk/ripplemap && npm run build -w @miraiwerk/aiml && npm run build -w @miraiwerk/backend && npm run build -w @miraiwerk/frontend
scripts.build:deps: npm run build -w @miraiwerk/schemas && npm run build -w @miraiwerk/ripplemap && npm run build -w @miraiwerk/aiml
scripts.test: npm run test -w @miraiwerk/ripplemap && npm run test -w @miraiwerk/backend
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:reset -w @miraiwerk/backend && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
